summary: Plan for adding a self-contained mystery & exploration adventure layer to Mahimur Rahman Khan's 3D driving portfolio: 3 glowing landmark stars, 4 clue signboards, a hidden Mystery Box with an inspiring personal message, a Secret Button triggering confetti fireworks and chimes, a 3-gem locked Secret Door leading to the Explorer Achievement screen, a compact Discoveries 0/3 HUD counter, and localStorage persistence.
